reviews.text: A fantastic experience! My call with Francis was incredibly helpful. He listened attentively and offered several tips and exercises to do with my dog, Luc. Following my call, I received a personalized report on Luc's behavior, along with a variety of training exercises and helpful tips. I highly recommend this company! 10/10
Francis was fantastic! Patient and very good at explaining things, both with the dog and with me, he gave me some really useful tools and tips. Lucky was exhausted after our 1.5 hours together!

Riannon is such an excellent trainer.  I have asked for her assistance with Dogs that I have fostered and always giving trick and advice as well as with my personal dogs she was a great trainer for them.  If you want basic to advance training she is the one to call.  if you want to do agility or sent tracking or anything you would like to do with your dog she is going to make it happen.  Do not miss the change to have a great trainer with you.  French or English she will be able to accommodate you

Rhiannon is a fantastic trainer. She understands dog behavior at a deep level and focuses on addressing the root causes rather than just the symptoms. She is empathetic and shows genuine interest in both the dog and its owner.
Riannon will always give you the straight facts about your dog. Her experience and resources are invaluable. For any behavioral issues, I highly recommend her!

Riannon is extremely competent and knows how to convey her knowledge effectively so that we can easily apply it ourselves. I consulted her for my anxious dog and several other issues with the dogs I walk (I'm a dog walker), and she always found solutions that worked well for me, aligned with my values, and focused on the dog's well-being. She has a holistic approach, and I have complete confidence in her expertise. She's the best!

Thank you, Julia, for your feedback. We're glad your experience was positive.

I asked lots of questions, and she explained everything clearly with a positive approach. I 100% recommend her for kind and effective training.

We met with Riannon for help with Lily, our Australian Shepherd. She was fantastic. She gave us excellent advice and we did some really interesting practical exercises. Afterwards, we received a summary of the session with links and documents to help us. I highly recommend her.
Thank you, Jacob!

Excellent service, great advice, treats provided, affordable prices, and all delivered to your door.
I highly recommend them.
Riannon is so helpful, kind and patient. She truly has a love for dogs and cares about their well-being. If you are hesitating, don't, it is worth booking her!

Riannon is so great! She takes the time to explain things thoroughly and also to listen. I feel well-informed and well-advised every time. I also appreciate her knowledge of dog breeds. The fit between the trainer and the dog is important, but I find the fit between the trainer and the pet parent even more so. Having consulted several trainers, she is truly my favorite. Pogo adores her too ❤️
My dog fell in love with Jessie right away.  She is so good with him and has already provided some great tricks.  Already making progress.  The follow up information is fantastic too
Great experience and follow up. We have see a significant change in our dog since we started taking courses with the team. Clearly a lot of experience with dogs, and different types of breeds.

Henri is much calmer at home, less reactive to every noise, and less agitated during walks. In short, I highly recommend Chrystel to anyone who needs support with their dog!
Very professional and seem very dedicated to their work. 10/10

I recently consulted a canine behaviorist from "Pour l'Amour des Chiens" (For the Love of Dogs) to address some aggressive behaviors my dog ​​had developed, and I am extremely satisfied with the experience. From the very first session, the advice was clear, professional, and, above all, perfectly tailored to our situation. The trainer's gentle approach allowed my dog ​​to relax quickly, and I noticed a significant improvement in his behavior by the end of the session.

I now feel better equipped to handle difficult situations and continue the work we've begun. I wholeheartedly recommend this service to anyone looking for concrete and effective solutions, with compassionate support that respects animal welfare.

Riannon is amazing! Helped with my dog from the first session and gave me the right way to approach my dogs issue. And helped with what needed to be done when I add a second pupp to the family!

Highly recommended 👍

Amazing help from Riannon today for our 3 months old Shiba Inu ! She came 2 hours after I called her and gave us so many great tips regarding the situation while bonding with our boy before the leash/stairs exercise. Thanks again Riannon !! Ryan is still smiling from the experience :)
Thank you Marie-Claude!

Riannon clearly has a love for dogs and a passion for what she does and I am excited to work with her again!

Riannon is super kind and knowledgable. She helped us out with our dachshund, providing simple but effective techniques that are already making a difference. The team was quick to respond and setting up an appointment was easy. Highly recommended.
I was so impressed with "Pour l'amour des Cheins" dog training.  Riannon took the time to listen to our issues and give us effective feedback.  Her training advice was clear, practical and realistic.

Riannon is so sweet, she is really in tune with our dogs and their person! The whole team is very human. I would recommend their services any time. I do not trust a lot of people with my dogs, but I'd leave them with Riannon always!
I love their feedback, the fact that they send pictures and videos! They never let you go without you understanding everything that you need to!
10/10 would do it again!

From the moment I fist contacted 'Pour l'Amour des Chiens / For the Love of Dogs' I was impressed with their customer service and communications.
We booked a consultation and we had an amazing experience with Riannon and so did our puppy!

Also, the documentation provided after the consultation, is great! Tons of great information and reminders of what was discussed.
We highly recommend 'Pour l'Amour des Chiens / For the Love of Dogs'! :)
